relations.subject: Chögyam Trungpa Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Khenpo Gangshar Wangpo (b. 1925-?) was a highly respected lama in Eastern Tibet and one of the primary teachers of Chögyam Trungpa Rinpoche (the 11th Trungpa tulku)

relations.subject: 9th Thrangu Rinpoche
relations.evidence: one of the primary teachers of Chögyam Trungpa Rinpoche (the 11th Trungpa tulku) and the 9th Thrangu Rinpoche.

relations.subject: Khenpo Gangshar Wangpo
relations.evidence: Gangshar Rinpoche was tutored by Jamgon Kongtrul the Second of Shechen Monastery.

relations.subject: Khenpo Gangshar Wangpo

relations.subject: Khenpo Gangshar Wangpo
